function.name: goto_place
function.description: Navigate to a verified named place.

function.name: goto
function.description: Navigate to a free map pose.

function.name: explore
function.description: Explore autonomously for a bounded number of minutes.

function.name: look
function.description: Aim the camera and save a view.

function.name: describe_view
function.description: Ask the vision-language model about the camera view (slow, several seconds). Use when a person asks what you see or roam_step reports something new; for presence checks use seen_objects.

function.name: assess_scene
function.description: Advisory scene assessment combining the camera with battery-free metric navigation context. It cannot command motion.

function.name: patrol
function.description: Visit a bounded sequence of verified places.

function.name: arm_pose
function.description: Move to a named bounded arm pose. forward = driving pose (required before goto/wander/explore); floor/ceiling = same arm, camera tilted.

function.name: pick_test
function.description: Run the bounded gripper open/close test.

function.name: where_am_i
function.description: Report pose and localization health.

function.name: relocalize
function.description: Re-find the robot on the map by global scan search. Call when where_am_i reports localization unhealthy or a goto/wander fails on localization; stand still while it runs.

function.name: stop
function.description: Immediately stop all motion and latch the estop. Clear it later with reset_estop.

function.name: reset_estop
function.description: Clear a latched estop so motion and arm commands are accepted again. Call it only when the surroundings are safe to move in.

function.name: drive
function.description: Raw timed velocity command (no feedback). Last resort: use turn, move or approach instead; they close the loop and stop on their own.

function.name: arm_aim
function.description: Point the arm-mounted camera. bearing rad (left positive, 0 = straight ahead), elevation rad (positive up).

function.name: arm_reach
function.description: Move the gripper tip to a point in the robot base frame (metres: x forward, y left, z up). Reach is short. Near the floor (z 0.02-0.10) only x 0.10-0.20 m is reachable, and only with tool_pitch about -0.8 (tilted down); at z 0.20, x 0.11-0.25. Anything farther: drive closer first. Points within 0.10 m of the arm axis below z 0.20 are keep-out.

function.name: gripper
function.description: Open or close the gripper.

function.name: say
function.description: Speak out loud through the robot's own speaker (max 400 characters; up to 3 utterances queue). Keep it to one or two sentences.

function.name: seen_objects
function.description: Fast object detection + tracking from the robot's camera (YOLO11s on the Jetson GPU, ~10 Hz). Lists COCO objects (person, chair, bottle, ...) with a stable track id, distance and bearing relative to the camera direction. Cheaper and faster than describe_view; use describe_view for detail.

function.name: wander
function.description: Go to a random reachable spot within max_distance; it points the arm forward, relocalizes and re-picks by itself. Report its result; don't retry it by hand.

function.name: turn
function.description: Turn in place by an exact angle and wait until done (closed loop on the gyro). Positive = left/counter-clockwise, 180 = turn around. Prefer this over drive for any rotation.

function.name: move
function.description: Move a measured distance forward, left or right and wait until done; refuses if the costmap path is blocked and stops if it becomes blocked. Prefer this over drive for any translation. The base cannot reverse.

function.name: approach
function.description: Find (turning in place up to one circle) and drive up to a detected object class, e.g. 'person' for 'come to me', stopping at stop_at_m. One call does the whole approach.

target.description: YOLO class name, e.g. person, chair, bottle

function.name: roam_step
function.description: One idle-life step: check objects, wander to a new spot, check again, and describe only objects not seen in the last 30 min. The whole life tick in one call.
